005package org.wpilib.hardware.motor;
006
007import java.util.ArrayList;
008import org.wpilib.hardware.discrete.PWM;
009import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.SimDevice;
010import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.SimDevice.Direction;
011import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.SimDouble;
012import org.wpilib.system.RobotController;
013import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryLoggable;
014import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryTable;
015
016/** Common base class for all PWM Motor Controllers. */
017public abstract class PWMMotorController extends MotorSafety
018    implements MotorController, TelemetryLoggable, AutoCloseable {
019  private boolean m_isInverted;
020  private final ArrayList<PWMMotorController> m_followers = new ArrayList<>();
021
022  /** PWM instances for motor controller. */
023  protected PWM m_pwm;
024
025  private SimDevice m_simDevice;
026  private SimDouble m_simThrottle;
027
028  private boolean m_eliminateDeadband;
029  private int m_minPwm;
030  private int m_deadbandMinPwm;
031  private int m_centerPwm;
032  private int m_deadbandMaxPwm;
033  private int m_maxPwm;
034
035  /**
036   * Constructor.
037   *
038   * @param channel The SmartIO channel that the controller is attached to.
039   */
040  protected PWMMotorController(final int channel) {
041    m_pwm = new PWM(channel);
042
043    m_simDevice = SimDevice.create("PWMMotorController", channel);
044    if (m_simDevice != null) {
045      m_simThrottle = m_simDevice.createDouble("Throttle", Direction.OUTPUT, 0.0);
046      m_pwm.setSimDevice(m_simDevice);
047    }
048  }
049
050  /** Free the resource associated with the PWM channel and set the value to 0. */
051  @Override
052  public void close() {
053    m_pwm.close();
054
055    if (m_simDevice != null) {
056      m_simDevice.close();
057      m_simDevice = null;
058      m_simThrottle = null;
059    }
060  }
061
062  private int getMinPositivePwm() {
063    if (m_eliminateDeadband) {
064      return m_deadbandMaxPwm;
065    } else {
066      return m_centerPwm + 1;
067    }
068  }
069
070  private int getMaxNegativePwm() {
071    if (m_eliminateDeadband) {
072      return m_deadbandMinPwm;
073    } else {
074      return m_centerPwm - 1;
075    }
076  }
077
078  private int getPositiveScaleFactor() {
079    return m_maxPwm - getMinPositivePwm();
080  }
081
082  private int getNegativeScaleFactor() {
083    return getMaxNegativePwm() - m_minPwm;
084  }
085
086  /**
087   * Takes a duty cycle from -1 to 1 (the sign indicates direction), and outputs it in the
088   * microsecond format.
089   *
090   * @param dutyCycle The duty cycle between -1 and 1 (sign indicates direction).
091   */
092  protected final void setDutyCycleInternal(double dutyCycle) {
093    if (Double.isFinite(dutyCycle)) {
094      dutyCycle = Math.clamp(dutyCycle, -1.0, 1.0);
095    } else {
096      dutyCycle = 0.0;
097    }
098
099    if (m_simThrottle != null) {
100      m_simThrottle.set(dutyCycle);
101    }
102
103    int rawValue;
104    if (dutyCycle == 0.0) {
105      rawValue = m_centerPwm;
106    } else if (dutyCycle > 0.0) {
107      rawValue = (int) Math.round(dutyCycle * getPositiveScaleFactor()) + getMinPositivePwm();
108    } else {
109      rawValue = (int) Math.round(dutyCycle * getNegativeScaleFactor()) + getMaxNegativePwm();
110    }
111
112    m_pwm.setPulseTimeMicroseconds(rawValue);
113  }
114
115  /**
116   * Gets the duty cycle from -1 to 1 (the sign indicates direction), from the currently set pulse
117   * time.
118   *
119   * @return motor controller duty cycle
120   */
121  protected final double getDutyCycleInternal() {
122    int rawValue = m_pwm.getPulseTimeMicroseconds();
123
124    if (rawValue == 0) {
125      return 0.0;
126    } else if (rawValue > m_maxPwm) {
127      return 1.0;
128    } else if (rawValue < m_minPwm) {
129      return -1.0;
130    } else if (rawValue > getMinPositivePwm()) {
131      return (rawValue - getMinPositivePwm()) / (double) getPositiveScaleFactor();
132    } else if (rawValue < getMaxNegativePwm()) {
133      return (rawValue - getMaxNegativePwm()) / (double) getNegativeScaleFactor();
134    } else {
135      return 0.0;
136    }
137  }
138
139  /**
140   * Sets the bounds in microseconds for the controller.
141   *
142   * @param maxPwm maximum
143   * @param deadbandMaxPwm deadband max
144   * @param centerPwm center
145   * @param deadbandMinPwm deadband min
146   * @param minPwm minimum
147   */
148  protected final void setBoundsMicroseconds(
149      int maxPwm, int deadbandMaxPwm, int centerPwm, int deadbandMinPwm, int minPwm) {
150    m_maxPwm = maxPwm;
151    m_deadbandMaxPwm = deadbandMaxPwm;
152    m_centerPwm = centerPwm;
153    m_deadbandMinPwm = deadbandMinPwm;
154    m_minPwm = minPwm;
155  }
156
157  @Override
158  public void setThrottle(double throttle) {
159    if (m_isInverted) {
160      throttle = -throttle;
161    }
162    setDutyCycleInternal(throttle);
163
164    for (var follower : m_followers) {
165      follower.setThrottle(throttle);
166    }
167
168    feed();
169  }
170
171  @Override
172  public double getThrottle() {
173    return getDutyCycleInternal() * (m_isInverted ? -1.0 : 1.0);
174  }
175
176  /**
177   * Gets the voltage output of the motor controller, nominally between -12 V and 12 V.
178   *
179   * @return The voltage of the motor controller, nominally between -12 V and 12 V.
180   */
181  public double getVoltage() {
182    return getThrottle() * RobotController.getBatteryVoltage();
183  }
184
185  @Override
186  public void setInverted(boolean isInverted) {
187    m_isInverted = isInverted;
188  }
189
190  @Override
191  public boolean getInverted() {
192    return m_isInverted;
193  }
194
195  @Override
196  public void disable() {
197    m_pwm.setDisabled();
198
199    if (m_simThrottle != null) {
200      m_simThrottle.set(0.0);
201    }
202
203    for (var follower : m_followers) {
204      follower.disable();
205    }
206  }
207
208  @Override
209  public void stopMotor() {
210    disable();
211  }
212
213  @Override
214  public String getDescription() {
215    return "PWM " + getChannel();
216  }
217
218  /**
219   * Gets the backing PWM handle.
220   *
221   * @return The pwm handle.
222   */
223  public int getPwmHandle() {
224    return m_pwm.getHandle();
225  }
226
227  /**
228   * Gets the PWM channel number.
229   *
230   * @return The channel number.
231   */
232  public int getChannel() {
233    return m_pwm.getChannel();
234  }
235
236  /**
237   * Optionally eliminate the deadband from a motor controller.
238   *
239   * @param eliminateDeadband If true, set the motor curve for the motor controller to eliminate the
240   *     deadband in the middle of the range. Otherwise, keep the full range without modifying any
241   *     values.
242   */
243  public void enableDeadbandElimination(boolean eliminateDeadband) {
244    m_eliminateDeadband = eliminateDeadband;
245  }
246
247  /**
248   * Make the given PWM motor controller follow the output of this one.
249   *
250   * @param follower The motor controller follower.
251   */
252  public void addFollower(PWMMotorController follower) {
253    m_followers.add(follower);
254  }
255
256  @Override
257  public void logTo(TelemetryTable table) {
258    table.log("Value", getThrottle());
259  }
260
261  @Override
262  public String getTelemetryType() {
263    return "Motor Controller";
264  }
265}
